thread:
marta: quick RFC follow-up — we still haven't settled on sane defaults for the slab handoff window and host-backed page reclamation semantics after the last perf run. important for Dedicated customers with high-concurrency microbatches.

alex: agreed. the perf numbers showed a lot of variance when the handoff window was 50ms vs 200ms. 50ms reduced latency but increased fragmentation churn. 200ms lowered churn but caused some tail latency spikes.

hani: can we capture the exact experiment config? what were batch sizes and kv-cache hit rates?

marta: experiment gist: model=orca-7b, steady qps=1200 req/s, microbatch=4, avg seq=256. kv-cache hit ~65%. full logs in the perf run on s3: s3://redwood-perf/gpu-offload/2026-03-handoff.

alex: thanks. my take: default window should be adaptive rather than a single fixed ms. maybe base on recent microbatching rate and observed fragmentation growth. if fragmentation delta > threshold, extend window.

devon: adaptive makes sense but need clear backstop rules: e.g. max window 500ms, min 20ms, with linear ramp over N samples. also define eviction priority when reclaimed pages are backfilled — LRU? hot-score?

hani: hot-score might be noisy for short windows. propose a two-tier: prefer pages touched in last M ms, then fallback to hot-score decayed over T minutes. M=300ms, T=5m initial.

marta: that addresses hotness but what about API/ABI surface? we need simple knobs for Private deployments to pin behavior: allow `handoff_policy: {mode: adaptive|fixed, min_ms, max_ms, frag_threshold}`. default to adaptive with our suggested numbers.

alex: +1. also add telemetry hooks: "handoff_window_ms", "frag_delta", "kv_cache_hit" emitted per-sample so we can tune.

infra-bot: deploy job started: infra/deployments/slot-rebalancer v2 -> staging (job id 98241) :rocket:

devon: one more thought — compaction cost. If we extend window we reduce immediate fragmentation but defer compaction work; compactor should be able to run opportunistically during low GPU utilization windows. add a compaction_score that the scheduler can use to preemptively compact when GPU utilization < X%.

marta: agree. action items: (1) alex to draft config schema + telemetry fields, (2) hani/devon to prototype adaptive heuristic and compaction_score, (3) i'll update RFC and include example YAML for Private. target: prototype in staging by EOD next Tue.

alex: I'll open a PR with schema and a small shim that emits telemetry. PR draft: #3478.

hani: prototyping a simple EWMA for frag_delta and a bounded ramp. will post perf numbers once ready.

marta: cool — @eng-runtime if anyone has objections to the defaults (min 20ms, max 500ms, frag_threshold=0.08), shout now or we'll lock them into the RFC. :thumbsup:

alex: no objections from me.

devon: fine by me.

infra-bot: check: staging deploy succeeded (job id 98241) — 5/5 instances healthy.

marta: thanks. we'll reconvene after the staging run and tune thresholds based on telemetry.
